name: journey-wrong-value-android
defect: drivers/android.sh against a device whose saved_date shows the clock's date (2026-11-21) after the journey entered 1999-01-02 — the discarded-date-picker defect. Another node does read 1999-01-02, which is exactly what the pre-QA-1 driver read and PASSed.
expected_signal: did not survive the round trip
why: QA-8: every other fixture here is caught by a detector written for it, and none needed a running app, so the journey drivers were never measured. This one plants a defect only a driven app shows; the device is a stub on PATH, the driver and gate are real.
